title: verify.rs: ECDSA verification imported via rsa::signature::Verifier — surprising, needs comment
description: In verify.rs (and cert.rs), ECDSA signature verification is called as rsa::signature::Verifier::verify(&verifying_key, ...). The trait comes from the rsa crate re-export of signature::Verifier, but the call is on a p256 VerifyingKey. A reader expecting ECDSA code to use a p256 import path will be confused by seeing rsa:: in that call. A comment like '// signature::Verifier trait, re-exported from the rsa crate' would clarify. Alternatively, add a direct use signature::Verifier import.
